description: Webpage summary — $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Two-phase flow: a first call with url (no 'payment') returns the live payment requirements; after payment from the caller's own wallet, a second call with 'payment' set to the base64 x402 payload returns the summary in the tool result. Cleaned-text excerpt plus key sentences; honors robots.txt (disallowed pages refused before any charge). This tool never pays and never touches private keys. Example: {url:'https://example.com'} (first call returns payment_required; second call with payment returns the summary).

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 v1 payment payload (the signed ExactEvmPayload JSON). Absent on the first call, which receives the payment requirements; present on the follow-up call, after signing in the caller's own wallet / x402 client. The server only forwards it to the rail — it never signs, never holds funds, never touches private keys.

name: qm_data_summarize
